annotations.target_phrase: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven was filling the grid between itself and the T-A ice with hypnotically intricate traceries of rainbow
annotations.annotation_text: The deployment of the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven: a Chinese military-grade icebreaker program that writes shimmering mathematical virus code across the defensive cores of Straylight's security matrix.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 218.

annotations.target_phrase: The construct’s hideous approximation of laughter scraped Case’s nerves like a dull blade.
annotations.annotation_text: The uncanny horror of McCoy Pauley's ROM construct: digital laughter without human vocal cords or emotional depth, highlighting the simulation of personality in post-biological constructs.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 218.
Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. (1999).
